page.layout: One printed page, centred dedication text in capitals, all lines in one block. Right edge shows part of the facing page with marginal text (show-through and edge of neighbouring page, not transcribed).
page.notes: The title lines are set as one dedication block; the line "IN GRATI, ET AD OBSEQUIA" is printed as shown with the abbreviation Q. with a superscript-like sign over it. Faint ghost text (show-through from the reverse, including a line at the foot reading roughly "...Lugd. ... 1613") is not transcribed. Words with the Q-abbreviation and the tilde-like mark over "OBSEQUIA" (printed as Q with a tail) are read as printed; "IPSORUM Q." is read as printed with a mark over the Q.
